judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Short, deadpan barks with a running gag (the forgotten 'no loitering' on the second click) and the jab at wizardry fit Nox's town guards and its anti-mage flavour exactly. Nothing over-explained; the only slight oddity is the trailing ellipsis line, which is still within Westwood's habits.
